dossier_meta.statement_text: For every $k$ satisfying $\Omega(\sqrt{n})=k<\sqrt{n}$, we have $m_{k}(n)\sim\left(1-\frac{k^{2}}{3n}\right)\frac{k}{\ln k}\cdot n$.
dossier_meta.context_text: If Conjecture 1 holds, it also resolves $m_k(n)$ asymptotically for $k\geqslant\sqrt{n}$ via Theorem 4. The only remaining open case is $k<\sqrt{n}$ with $k\not=o(\sqrt{n})$, which this conjecture addresses.
